name: Magnhilda
quote: The Octagon holds within it a fierce beast, one of raging fists rather than menacing roars.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Oh, you look quite energetic.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: A boxer's training never ends!

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Protein and electrolyte supplements are a must.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: The Midnight Underground Tournament is starting soon! You can look forward to my performance, hehe!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Hmph, I won't deny one can make up for some of their shortcomings with skill, but boxing is ultimately a clash of weight, raw strength, and resolve.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Have you seen all the bruises and scars littered on my body? Those are all badges of honor for me as a boxer.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Did you just doze off again? Huh, you really should be more alert.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Professor, are you interested in boxing? If you'd like, you can come find me in the gym.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Yeah?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: What do you need?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Hmph...

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Well then, let's get started.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Magnhilda here! Nothing stands a chance before my fists!

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: I can throw punches faster now!

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Alright, who's next!!

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: I shall imbue my fists with hellfire, and watch them quiver before my rage!

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Magnhilda is ready!

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Game on!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Ora ora ora!!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Cyber World Boxing Champion Legend!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: You'll be dead in 3... Oh, you're dead already.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Damn it...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Perhaps, deep down, we're the same breed.
We both chose our paths with no hesitation or regret, and we do whatever it takes to keep going.
I feel at ease to entrust you with our future together.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: New Year's Day? I like to break some sweat in the underground gym, crushing those who dare challenge me and shattering their unrealistic fantasies—and finally, knocking out the final challenger when the bell tolls, to announce the arrival of the new year. That's my ideal way to celebrate this day.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Here, it's a chocolate-flavored protein bar. It's the same as the ones you'd often see at convenience stores, but it tastes great. It's an essential snack for boxers as well.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: I don't have the habit of celebrating holidays like most people do. Since you've done so much to invite me over, guess I'll keep you company for a while... A watermelon? Why?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Isn't it boring to dress up as monsters and ghosts? We should do Bernand instead! The legendary hero who stood up to the Vampire Count. It's said that his descendants are still living somewhere...

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Today, I saw a guy dressed up as Santa Claus in the underground arena. He must've thought he was being funny... He was actually surprisingly good at fighting, but I managed to win in the end. Oh, and a ton of lollipops dropped out of his gift bag!

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Hey! Isn't it your birthday today? Well, let's have some fun together then! No matter if it's sumo wrestling or fisticuffs, I'll gladly be your opponent!

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: You know what kind of people I hate the most? Those who commit despicable acts in fancy clothes. Under their righteous façade lies a corrupted heart.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
Back in the old days, boxing used to be a free and unfettered sport. 
People released the pent-up adrenaline and animalistic impulses within their hearts. Finding a moment of pure release, for the metaphorical tiger of their hearts to break free of its shackles.
I felt the same. I was so lost in exhilarating battles that I even forgot that I was a Doll.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: Boxer Dolls like me can feel pain too. It's merely the product of simulated signals, but it makes us feel alive.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
I'll never hesitate about the choices I make.
I'll fight for my future with my own two fists.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Haha, am I too much of a brute for you?
That being said, I'm surprised as well; you didn't seem to be turned off by what I said at all.
In other words, I'm going to take it that you agreed with me. Is that alright?

career:
The AAT is Svarog Heavy Industries' sparring Doll, designed to military Doll standards.  The AAT's body is based on Latina stock and is programmed with officially-released biodata of military and athletic personnel from around the world, which it can consult in real time in order to better assist her training partner. The provided consultation data covers ages from 6 to 50; clients outside this range are not suitable users for the AAT Doll's companion protection protocols.

Magnhilda was once a member of a San Carlos boxing club, but went missing after an armed conflict. Several months later, she attracted notice in a certain boxing tournament, and following a recommendation from her friend Vee, she passed the screening examinations and joined Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
In order to help the AAT better perform its duties as a sparring partner, Svarog HI designed an entire suite of environmental analysis and body simulation systems to allow them to adjust themselves in real-time to match their current environment and user, as well as simulating the various forms of biofeedback encountered during a sparring session, such as excitement, pain, fatigue and so on.

This design gave Magnhilda a brand new way of learning that was different from most other sparring Dolls on the market, and afforded her a more humanlike experience of the sparring process. Magnhilda  could analyze every last bit of feedback from her sensor networks and use her existing training to develop her body and break through her limits. 

But according to Magnhilda, her passion for training did not stem simply from honing her abilities but more from the joy she felt in her neural cloud during the process. Perhaps she better understood the meaning of the words, "life is movement" better than most humans could.

Though Magnhilda is passionate about training herself, it does not mean that she believes that might makes right. On the contrary, she has never taken advantage of her physical abilities to make her life easier for herself.

Magnhilda is keenly aware that many humans and Dolls had no choice over the bodies they were born with. She believes that many of them are strong purely due to design decisions by their makers, rather than through tireless training. There are many people in the world who can't become stronger through effort and hard work, and she has seen far too many of them.

Therefore, Magnhilda has never once looked down on the weak. She is willing to help everyone who faces difficulty due to physical defects. Though conditions do not permit it, she has always hoped for the chance to volunteer in a human rights organization.

In the beginning, Magnhilda was a sparring Doll for a boxing club called the "Funky Hounds". After repeated victories during internal sparring matches, her fame gradually began to spread. To an outsider, it might not be strange for a human to lose to a Doll, but every pro boxer who watched Magnhilda's sparring videos was surprised by her performance. She did not leverage her special advantages as a Doll to fight, but instead employed the speed and technique earned through training to demonstrate the secrets of boxing to humans.

As her training videos became more and more popular, an increasing number of people began to look favorably upon the boxing club. Naturally, Magnhilda's owner was delighted by this. He often said in a half-joking fashion that Magnhilda might end up being the spokesperson for the club.

If the war had not happened, that might have very well come true.

Due to changes in regional politics, many matches were called off and many clubs and training groups disbanded. Magnhilda too fled the area at her owner's request, going far from home. 

Given Magnhilda's fame, she should have had many options once the situation stabilized. However, fate is cruel, and during her exile, she ran into a boxer who was previously fired by her club. That boxer since became a local fixer running an underground boxing ring. While it was not clear if he was trying to use her or simply because he wanted revenge, the man took control of Magnhilda through illegal means and drew her into underground boxing matches where the thrill of flirting with death took center stage.

With no recourse, Magnhilda spent a long, painful time in that place. She no longer fought for her own goals, but for filthy lucre.

Forbidden war machines, wanted criminals and biological chimeras... Magnhilda fought all manner of monsters while trapped in the underground boxing ring. She had no choice but to fight over and over again to survive. Even so, there were times when she was forced to throw matches and lose at the behest of her employer, even if it meant her body was incapacitated or left unable to move for several weeks.

Magnhilda struggled in this hellish environment for many years, until she gained the chance to take part in a boxing tournament that took humans and Dolls, named "Wishing Fist". This was also the occasion that brought Magnhilda and Vee together.

"Sometimes, I think about what would have happened if you hadn't walked my way. I'd probably still be stuck struggling in that lightless cage... Or perished on my feet in the ring."
"What brought that on? You came as far as you did because of your own efforts. If there's anyone you should be thanking, it's yourself."
"Perhaps I should thank that customer back then? You were so oppressive that it was a little scary..."
"Watch out, or I'll turn up your pain sensitivity!"

- Audio Log from the Medical Department's Doll Surgery Ward A05, Room 31
oathDesc: Breaking her shackles in the squared circle.

projections.name: Unyielding Fist
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"A fighting spirit undaunted by countless battles ignites the fervor to strike the darkness."

projections.name: Unyielding Fist
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"A fighting spirit undaunted by countless battles ignites the fervor to strike the darkness."

projections.name: King of the Ring
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Break your chains with your steely arms and crush your shackles with your mighty fists. The victor stands in the squared circle, welcoming the cheers that are rightfully hers."

skinList.name: Wishing Projection
skinList.desc:
Warming fireworks fill the silent night, and as the embers fall, they transform into countless candleflames. This is the most beautiful scene that the Dolls left behind on a Qixi summer night.
"Will you be able to understand my heart if you take this candied hawthorn?"

skinList.name: Flame-Baptised Steel
skinList.desc: The first awakening of Doll has the same level of importance as birth to a human being. Memories are reproduced in Magrasea via Neural Cloud Projection— "Being newly awakened aside, the desire for the fight inside me burns like a flame... Haha, I'm more than ready to go and get busy in the ring."

skinList.name: Night of Peace
skinList.desc:
From the "Classical Repertoire" Series — presenting film legends of old with the latest in modern technology as a tribute to milestones in movie history.
"Convictions are like forests; go too deep into them and you'll end up lost. More often than not, we have to blaze a trail for ourselves with fists or other weapons."

skinList.name: Fool's Duality
skinList.desc:
True desires slip forth unwittingly as Dolls take on new forms with the help of mysterious powers. Reality and fiction interweave, take care to not be too absorbed in a fool's game.
""I'm burning away... a sacrifice to dangerous proteins...""
